description: Dataset-specific defaults and differences for the Xenium H&E tiling pipelines.

datasets.name: 10x
datasets.description: Create aligned H&E tiles and XOA-cluster labels for 10x breast samples.
datasets.input_layout: Standard 10x Xenium output plus an H&E OME-TIFF per sample.
datasets.he_alignment: Base-panel samples are prealigned; add-on samples use downloaded/supplied 3x3 affine CSVs.
datasets.cell_labels: Use <sample>_cell_groups.csv when present; otherwise fall back to XOA graphclust clusters.
notes: Alignment is auto-required only when the resolved H&E filename indicates an unaligned image.

datasets.name: Janesick_2023
datasets.description: Create aligned H&E tiles and author cell-type labels for Janesick 2023.
datasets.sample_discovery: Sample folders live directly under Janesick_2023.
datasets.input_layout: Standard 10x Xenium output plus H&E OME-TIFF images; some samples are packaged in large outer archives.
datasets.he_alignment: Rep1 and Rep2 use downloaded/supplied 3x3 affine CSVs; Preview Sample 2 uses Xenium Explorer alignment import.
datasets.cell_labels: Use author <sample>_cell_groups.csv files derived from Cell_Barcode_Type_Matrices.xlsx when present; otherwise fall back to XOA graphclust clusters.
notes: Selective extraction avoids unpacking unnecessary large archive members.
Author cell-group annotations can be converted from Cell_Barcode_Type_Matrices.xlsx into per-sample <sample>_cell_groups.csv files when available.

datasets.name: Janesick_2025
datasets.description: Create aligned H&E tiles and published labels for Janesick 2025.
datasets.sample_discovery: Sample folders live directly under Janesick_2025.
datasets.input_layout: Standard 10x Xenium output plus H&E OME-TIFF images and published per-cell group files.
datasets.he_alignment: Each sample uses a downloaded/supplied <sample>_he_imagealignment.csv affine CSV.
datasets.cell_labels: Require <sample>_cell_groups.csv; cells absent from that file are retained as Unannotated.
notes: The completion marker mirrors the original notebook behavior for output-only checkouts.

datasets.name: Liu_2025
datasets.description: Create aligned H&E tiles and XOA-cluster labels for Liu 2025.
datasets.sample_discovery: Sample folders live directly under Liu_2025.
datasets.input_layout: Standard 10x Xenium output plus external H&E OME-TIFF images.
datasets.he_alignment: External H&E images use downloaded/supplied 3x3 affine CSVs; the pipeline inverts them for Xenium-to-H&E mapping.
datasets.cell_labels: The shared Input_gene_groups CSV is a panel/marker file, not per-cell labels; use reviewed <sample>_cell_groups.csv if added, otherwise XOA graphclust clusters.
notes: Alignment is auto-required only when the resolved H&E filename indicates an unaligned image.

datasets.name: Bilous_2026
datasets.description: Create Bilous 2026 H&E tiles from selected Xenium alignments.
datasets.input_layout: GEO tabular Xenium files plus separately extracted full-resolution H&E candidate regions.
datasets.he_alignment: Uses project landmark alignment after verified H&E-to-sample mapping; selected transforms are exported as affine CSVs.
datasets.cell_labels: Use a requested cells.parquet label column, custom cell annotation CSV if present, or Unassigned.
notes: This remains dataset-specific until the external H&E mapping and landmark-selection workflow is generalized.
